items.title: Pointed form of the quasi-finite splitting: an etale neighbourhood whose pullback has one finite piece through the given point
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y separated locally of finite type between algebraic spaces over S, and x over y, if f is quasi-finite at x the lemma produces an etale morphism of pointed spaces (U, u) -> (Y, y) and an open-and-closed decomposition U x_Y X = W coproduct V with V -> U finite and V containing a point mapping to x (and u). The retained proof is written: pick a scheme U etale over Y with u over y (charts exist by definition of algebraic space); the cartesian-points lemma (Properties of Spaces, lemma points-cartesian) supplies x' in |U x_Y X| over (x, u); apply the already-collected splitting lemma etale-splits-off-quasi-finite-part to U x_Y X -> U at x', noting its pointedness hypothesis is satisfied because U is a scheme so u comes from Spec kappa(u) -> U. Retained author proof at lines 7563-7572.
